A classic topic. The Lord of the Rings is a high fantasy novel by J.R.R. Tolkien, published in three volumes: The Fellowship of the Ring (1954), The Two Towers (1954), and The Return of the King (1955). 

The story revolves around a hobbit, Frodo Baggins, who inherits the One Ring from Bilbo Baggins and learns it must be destroyed in the fires of Mount Doom to prevent the dark lord Sauron's return to power.
